description: This source file defines the ExecAllowlistMatcher enum which provides static methods for matching execution commands against an allowlist of patterns. It includes functions for verifying whether a command's resolved path or raw executable matches specified patterns using regex-based pattern matching.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Matches a single command resolution against a list of allowlist entries to find a matching entry.

methods.name: matchAll
methods.description: Returns all allowlist entries that match a list of command resolutions.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Determines if a target string matches a pattern, considering tilde expansion and regex pattern matching.

methods.name: normalizeMatchTarget
methods.description: Normalizes path strings by replacing backslashes with slashes and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: regex
methods.description: Generates an NSRegularExpression object from a pattern string with wildcard conversions.
